gloss: pudding à la mode; custard pudding with fruit and ice cream

definitions.gloss: pudding à la mode; custard pudding with fruit and ice cream
definitions.explanation: A Japanese café dessert of custard pudding served on a plate with whipped cream, ice cream, and assorted fruit.

examples.japanese: {喫茶店|きっさてん}でプリンアラモードを{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered a pudding à la mode at the coffee shop.

examples.japanese: このプリンアラモードは{果物|くだもの}がたっぷりだ。
examples.english: This pudding à la mode has plenty of fruit.

examples.japanese: {昭和|しょうわ}の{喫茶店|きっさてん}で{人気|にんき}だったプリンアラモードが、{今|いま}{再|ふたた}び{注目|ちゅうもく}されている。
examples.english: Pudding à la mode, which was popular in Shōwa-era coffee shops, is getting attention again.

notes:
From English "pudding à la mode." A retro café dessert that pairs {固|かた}めのプリン (custard pudding) with ice cream, whipped cream, and fruit on a single plate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プリンアラモードを{注文|ちゅうもん}する: to order a pudding à la mode
- {昔|むかし}ながらのプリンアラモード: old-fashioned pudding à la mode

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プリン: custard pudding — the plain dessert on its own, without the fruit and ice cream.
